hook: Investing has never been easier to start, and it's never been easier to make expensive beginner mistakes. In this video I go through 20 of them from three angles: the numbers (waiting, fees, skipping the match, taxes), the psychology (panic, hype, overconfidence) and the playbook (plans, simplicity, rebalancing), plus what to do instead of each one.
shorts: Most beginner investors lose money for the same few reasons
If your job offers this and you skip it, you're turning down free money
The worst investing move happens when you're most scared
Thousands of employees lost their retirement savings because of this one mistake
Two beginners started investing the same year. Only one made money
